summary: bioAffinity Technologies, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 27, 2026, under Item 8.01, disclosing a press release that announces receipt of a patent allowance from the Mexican Institute of Industrial Property for a method to predict lung cancer likelihood using flow cytometry. The filing is a routine current report on other events—a patent-related announcement—and does not involve any M&A, activist, capital return, restructuring, or other special-situation activity. No deal terms are present, and no roles such as acquirer, target, seller, or issuer are applicable. No watch or risk-arb angle exists.
